A browser-based follow-up to [my earlier post on Head Related Transfer Functions](../blog/head_related_tfs.qmd). An audio can be processed to sound like it's coming from a specific point in space around your head. This version runs entirely client-side, so performance may vary depending on your hardware.

**Headphones required** — binaural spatialization depends on each ear hearing an independent signal, which speakers can't give you.

Works best in Chrome or Edge. Firefox and safari work too, but can be slower. Use the ⛶ button in the corner to enter full screen mode.
